flags.reason: Two guides offer an action menu. This guide's summary uses Dropdown Menu for “a short list of actions that opens from a button, such as an overflow or account menu”, while the Dropdown guide (889444e) uses Dropdown for “a short list of choices or actions that opens from a button or field”, and its In context is the same overflow menu on a September statement card (Download statement, Share statement, Report a problem); the Dropdown entry's useWhen says so too. Neither guide says which one an action menu uses, so this entry doesn't decide it: it gives no avoidWhen for Dropdown, and the Dropdown entry none for Dropdown Menu.
